units.name: DrivingIntegrateThreeAxes
units.summary: Integrate height and lateral fractional/integer positions, sign-extend depth velocity into the third depth byte and enter the shared range/removal test. Following entries provide independent axis addition, signed negation, scratch-vector addition, fixed-point conversion, steering and target clamping. X is a valid driving object slot; these are arithmetic helpers, not independent natural-entry assertions.

units.name: DrivingIntegrateHeight
units.summary: Add the two-byte height velocity into the matching fractional/integer height position with carry.

units.name: DrivingIntegrateLateral
units.summary: Add the two-byte lateral velocity into the matching fractional/integer lateral position with carry.

units.name: DrivingNegateLateralVelocity
units.summary: Negate the two-byte lateral velocity with borrow propagated from its fractional byte.

units.name: DrivingNegateHeightVelocity
units.summary: Negate the two-byte height velocity with borrow propagated from its fractional byte.

units.name: DrivingNegateDepthVelocity
units.summary: Negate the two-byte depth velocity with borrow propagated from its fractional byte.

units.name: DrivingAddLateralScratch
units.summary: Add scratch $00/$01 to the object's lateral fractional/integer position.

units.name: NegateScratchWord
units.summary: Negate scratch $00/$01 as a little-endian word, propagating borrow into the high byte.

units.name: DrivingAddHeightScratch
units.summary: Add scratch $02/$03 to the object's height fractional/integer position.

units.name: DrivingAddDepthScratch
units.summary: Sign-extend scratch $04/$05 and add it to the object's three-byte depth position, then apply the shared range/removal test.

units.name: DrivingAddDepthAcceleration
units.summary: Sign-extend A and add it to the object's two-byte depth velocity. Entry flags determine the sign-extension byte.

units.name: DrivingSetDepthSpeedUnsigned
units.summary: Multiply the unsigned byte in A by sixteen using shift/rotate, then store both halves in the depth velocity pair.

units.name: DrivingSetDepthSpeed
units.summary: Convert A to a two-byte value scaled by sixteen and write the depth velocity pair.

units.name: DrivingSetLateralSpeed
units.summary: Convert A to a two-byte value scaled by sixteen and write the lateral velocity pair.

units.name: DrivingSetHeightSpeedSigned
units.summary: Preserve the caller's sign flag, scale A by sixteen, write height velocity and restore sign extension when the saved sign was negative.

units.name: ScaleByteBySixteen
units.summary: Shift A left four times, returning the low byte in A and the carried high byte in scratch $00. Y is consumed as the shift counter.

units.name: DrivingAccumulateHeightAcceleration
units.summary: Sign-extend A and add it into the height velocity pair. Detect height position overflow and mark the scratch collision/clamp flag; out-of-range depth removes the object. The shared sign-extension byte is scratch $19.

units.name: DrivingAimLateralTarget
units.summary: Use a two-entry target table, derive lateral velocity from depth velocity and reverse its sign when needed to head toward the selected target. Zero velocity when already aligned.
